title: QA run · release-18.2.0-w2-manual-api (29/29) · 756220c4 · 2026-10-27 · 27 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record for the 18.2.0 release sweep, wave 2, card W2-C3a: the manual set, api / cli / build half (wave anchor #25807). The subject is the release head `756220c4`, against the Version Packages PR #25640. Run with the `checklist-test` skill, following `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` and the `dogfood-verification` skill.

This record supersedes the api/cli/build half of the wave-1 manual set #25817, which ran at `6679644a`. The browser half belongs to sibling card W2-C3b. Every item in this card's list was re-judged here, so nothing needs to be carried forward from #25817 for this half (see "Supersede" below).

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `756220c4a7adcbb1228864607cb4b6a1ca486dc0`, detached. It was a cold tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, 119/119 tasks, 0 cached, 11m54s. `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` is green. The tree is unreleased, so health reports `18.1.0`; the protocol handshake reports protocolVersion `18.0.0`.
- **Console:** not separately built (`pnpm console:build` was not run). Only one clause needs it: `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract` A6, the Studio reachability half.
  - A tree boot's `/_console/` answered 503 "Console is not built … run pnpm console:build", because `pnpm build` leaves `packages/console/dist` absent.
  - So that leg ran on a scratch app copy whose `@objectstack/console` resolves to `ui/apps/console/dist`, the in-repo console that `pnpm build` produced from this same commit at 01:41Z.
  - `.objectui-sha` is retired, and the console is the `ui/` tree of this commit.
- **App and boot:** `examples/app-showcase`, booted with `OS_PORT=PORT setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/RUNNER/BOOT.db`. Every boot had its own port in 42100–42699 and its own file DB. The seed was `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the showcase seed. Every server was stopped by process group, and its port was confirmed free.
  - Scratch app copies (tar, without `node_modules`, `dist` or `.objectstack`; `node_modules` symlinked to the tree's copy) were used for:
    - every `os build` / `os compile` / `os migrate` leg, built from the blank scaffold;
    - the production `os serve` fresh-install leg (random `OS_AUTH_SECRET` / `OS_SECRET_KEY`);
    - every install-local and manifest-install boot;
    - the connector-degraded twins;
    - the Studio leg.
  - `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed.
  - The tree boots did write `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/` (`uploads/`, `showcase_external.db`). It is git-ignored, so `git status` stayed clean, but a per-boot `-d` DB does not isolate these two (see the accuracy findings).
- **Special switches:**
  - `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` on the two-factor armed boot, with an unarmed control boot;
  - `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` on the install-local B boot;
  - `--log-level info` on the connector-degraded boot;
  - `NODE_OPTIONS=--import packages/cli/test/fixtures/live-conversion-probe.mjs` only on the build/validate conversion-parity legs;
  - `mfa_required` / grace were changed via `PUT /api/settings/auth` and restored.
  - No walled posture, and no scheduled-work switch.
- **Execution:** six runner subagents ran in parallel, one per port range: R1 access/approvals · R2 api-backend + retests · R3 automation/MCP + retests · R4 two-factor/search/storage · R5 cli/build · R6 platform-core/connector. The coordinator built the tree and ran one smoke boot (42000, healthy, stopped). `git status --porcelain` was empty at the end.
- **Timings (UTC, 2026-10-27):**
  - Env prep: 01:29 to 01:43, about 14 min (install 0.5 min, build 12 min, smoke boot 1 min).
  - Testing wall clock: 01:43 to 02:02, about 19 min.
  - Runner-minutes: in-run prep (boots, personas, scratch copies) about 25, clauses about 64, off-clause probes about 32.

## Scope

The set is named by hand (card W2-C3a). It holds the unpinned `since:v18.x` items plus the unpinned P1 items whose `source[]` cites a file changed by a `Clause-②: yes` changeset in #25640. P0 items are excluded (card W2-C1). Every id was resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json`: all 29 are runnable, none is blocked or planned, and none carries an `automated.ref`, so every clause was driven live (REST / CLI).

One authz-adjacent probe observation, judged by design by its runner, is listed below with its detail withheld pending maintainer.

## Retests of the wave-1 extractions (#25818–#25822, all closed completed)

All five fixes hold at `756220c4`. Each was judged with fresh live requests.

- **#25818 holds** (PR #25935). On `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query`:
  - `dateGranularity` on text `name` → 400 `INVALID_FIELD` ("only a date or datetime field can be date-bucketed. The query was NOT run").
  - A duplicate alias `n` → 400 `INVALID_QUERY` ("aggregations.1.alias names the column 'n', which aggregations.0.alias already names").
  - alias `status` beside groupBy `status` → 400 `INVALID_QUERY` ("…which groupBy.0 already names").
  - Also refused: a currency field with granularity, an alias equal to an object-form groupBy field, and a duplicate groupBy.
  - Still allowed: a case-different alias (`N` / `n`) and month on `created_at`.
- **#25819 holds** (PR #25935).
  - `{"aggregations":[]}` → 400 `INVALID_QUERY` "'query.aggregations' is an empty list … The query was NOT run", never "not registered".
  - groupBy `[]` with aggregations `[]` → 400.
  - groupBy `["status"]` with aggregations `[]` → 200 (3 groups).
  - Control: one count → 200 `[{n:17}]`.
- **#25820 holds** (PR #25944). It was retested twice, by R3 and independently by R1. The run was paused via `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/showcase_reassign_wizard`.
  - Resume via `showcase_project_closure`, and via the unknown name `qa_nope_flow` → the identical 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND`.
  - `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase_notify_owner/runs/RUNID` → 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND`.
  - The run stays paused and the assignee is unchanged.
  - Via the owning flow: GET → 200 paused, and resume → 200 completed.
- **#25821 holds** (PR #25974, extended by #26034).
  - Both trigger routes of `showcase_notify_owner` with `params` set to `"oops"`, `[1,2]`, `null`, `42` or `true` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, with `details.fields[0] = {field:"params", code:"invalid_type"}`.
  - The flow's run count was 2 before the ten calls and 2 after, so no run row was written.
  - Beside it, `/actions` with params `"oops"` → 400 (#25976).
- **#25822 holds** (PR #25983).
  - `PUT /api/v1/meta/translation/qa_bad_locale` with locale `not a locale!!` → 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, issues[0] path `locale`, code `invalid_format`, "must be a BCP-47 language tag". Reproduced twice; a GET afterwards → 404.
  - Controls `zh-CN` and `zh-Hans-CN` save 200 with `valid:true`, and were cleaned up with DELETE.
  - The probe line below has a low follow-up note on the message wording.

## Per-clause evidence (one line per clause; text oracles)

Labels: `AK` = acceptance[K], `NK` = negative[K], zero-based.

### access-security.record-share-grant-revoke (R1)
Personas were members A, B, C and D, minted by invite then sign-up, each with `sys_member` role `member` read back.
- A0 pass: B's GET of note N1 → 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and B's list has 0 rows.
- A1 pass: A's `POST …/N1/shares {user,B,read}` → 201. The row reads recipient_type user, recipient B, access read, source manual, granted_by A.
- A2 pass: B by id → 200 and B's list has n=1. C → 404 and C's list has 0 rows.
- A3 pass: A's GET of the shares → 200 with the grant. B's self-grant, B granting C and B listing the shares → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` "requires record ownership or Modify All Data (ADR-0111 D1)".
- A4 pass: A's DELETE of the share → 204. B → 404, B's list is empty, and the system re-read → 404.
- A5 pass (run before the real revoke): DELETE of the share id under N2 → 404 "share … not found on showcase_private_note/N2". The share survived, and B still read N1 (200).
- A6 pass: `POST /sharing/rules/share_key_account_qualified_contacts_with_managers/evaluate` → 200 `{matchedRecords:1, expandedUsers:1, grantsCreated:0…}`. After a manager position was assigned to D, expandedUsers is 2. The rule rows on Nora West are admin + D, with source rule and source_id = the ruleId. D reads 200 and C reads 403.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.

### access-security.owd-save-gate (R1)
- A0 pass: `PUT /meta/object/qa_owd_probe` carrying `externalSharingModel` → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` on both the active door and `?mode=draft`. There is one issue, at `externalSharingModel`, with the "removed in @objectstack/spec 18 … Delete the key." prescription. Nothing was stored (404 / `NO_DRAFT`).
- A1 pass: without the key → 200 (active, seq 1), and the read-back shows sharingModel private with no externalSharingModel.
- A2 pass:
  - Widening `showcase_announcement` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, and with `?package=` → 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`. The tightened control is refused the same way, so the package door answers.
  - The R1 pins were run at 756220c4: `object-posture-gate.test.ts` 10/10 (plugin-unit layer) and `meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts` 11/11 (rest protocol layer, in-process).
- A3 pass: GET before and after are byte-identical (sha256 b550eb72…).
- A4 pass: `showcase_account` and `showcase_announcement` carry sharingModel, with no externalSharingModel.
- N0 pass (server half; surface api).
- N1 pass.

- A1 pass: `PUT /automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with the same lock text, and the read-back is byte-identical.
- A2 pass: `DELETE /automation/…` → 403 ("sealed against removal"). The GET afterwards → 200, identical.

### api-backend.filter-comparand-conformance (R2)
- A0 pass: 6 comparand members. The string / number / boolean / null / ISO-date cases through POST `where` and GET `?filter=` → 200 with ids identical to the local baseline. Date and bigint were scored in process, through spec `parseFilterAST` + the InMemoryDriver dist.
- A1 pass: object comparands → 400 (POST `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.where.title.$eq`; GET `INVALID_FILTER`), naming the path, "NOT applied" and no rows. An array in a scalar slot → a located 400 prescribing `$in` / `$between`.
- A2 pass (engine + driver layers): `engine-comparand-type-door.test.ts` 12/12. The driver suites: memory 23/23, sql 46 passed + 2 skipped, sqlite-wasm 22/22, turso 22/22, mongodb 22/22. An out-of-range bigint gives `INVALID_FILTER` "magnitude exceeds 2^53".
- A3 pass:
  - A relation head `project.name`, a scalar head `title.foo` and a virtual head `budget_remaining.x` → 400 `INVALID_FIELD` on both doors.
  - The nesting prescription works (200, 5 rows).
  - A JSON head → 400 `INVALID_FILTER` from the driver; it is not dropped.
- A4 pass: the same sentence at POST, GET and the engine.
- N0–N3 pass.

### api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix (R2)
Planted rows: a null revenue, plus dates 2024-11-24, 2024-12-30 and 2027-01-03. The baseline is 17 rows.
- A0 pass: 0 mismatches across the 6 functions, grouped and ungrouped. `count(field)` 16 vs fieldless 17. On a boolean, min/max are the numbers 0 / 1.
- A1 pass (clock 01:50Z UTC): day 15, week 15, month 12, quarter 9, year 5 buckets, all equal to the ISO computation. The null dates form one null bucket. Weeks: 2024-11-24 → 2024-W47, 2024-12-30 → 2025-W01, 2027-01-03 → 2026-W53. Quarter keys read `YYYY-Qn`.
- A2 pass: on an empty where, count 0, sum 0, avg/min/max null, count_distinct 0; grouped, `[]`. A per-measure filter empties only its own measure.
- A3 pass: `array_agg` / `string_agg` → 400 with the retirement text and `os migrate meta --from 16`. `median` → 400 naming the six functions. An unknown field → 400 `INVALID_FIELD`. A non-array → 400.
- A4 pass: the contributor-bound member sees 0 seeded invoices and INV-1003 → 404. Their grouped count is `{draft:1}`; the admin's is `{draft:3, paid:5, sent:5}`.
- A5 pass: 11 variant rows, all 5 granularities discriminating.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.
- N2 pass: `/analytics/query` day buckets give the same label/count sets under UTC, America/Los_Angeles and Pacific/Auckland.

### attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced (R4)

### automation.trigger-status-contract (R3)
- A0 pass: the `qa-flow-status-doors` recipe provisioned live. Both trigger routes answer:
  - unknown → 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`
  - always-fails → 400 `FLOW_FAILED`
  - disabled → 409 `FLOW_DISABLED`
  - no start node → 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`
  - valid → 200
  No refusal comes back as a 200 wrapping `success:false`.
- A1 pass: the wizard → 200 `{status:'paused', runId, screen.nodeId:'collect'}`, later resumed to completed.
- A2 pass:
  - With the wizard disabled, `/actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign` → 409.
  - With `showcase_inquiry_purge` disabled, `POST /api/v1/apps/showcase/inquiries/purge` → 409.
  - Type:'flow' actions authored under the QA package → 400 `FLOW_FAILED` and 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`.
  - All three doors import `classifyFlowRefusal`.
- A3 pass: `details.errorMessage` and `details.summary` at the trigger door and at `/actions`.
- A4 partial (6 arms pass; each retryable arm was re-read as still paused):
  - `{inputs:{}}` and bodyless → 400 `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`
  - output `$x` → 400 `INVALID_SIGNAL`
  - inputs + variables → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`
  - member → 403
  - a concurrent resume during a 6 s http node → 409 `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS`
  - unknown or consumed run → 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND`
  - **The 503 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` arm is blocked(fixture):** no stock trigger reaches it.
- A5 pass: a flow deregistered under a pause → 404 "Flow 'qa_stale_dereg' not found for run". A node edited away → 404 "Suspended node 'collect' no longer exists".
- A6 pass: live `@objectstack/client`: `trigger()` / `execute()` reject 404 / 400 / 409 / 422, and `resume()` rejects 400 / 400 / 403 / 404. The success, paused and valid-resume calls resolve.
- N0–N5 pass.
